```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(viridisLite)
library(ggrepel)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(scales)
library(viridisLite)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
set.seed(314)
```

```{r}
# Repo-relative paths: inputs from imports_stable/, outputs to analysis_outs/<module>/
repo_dir <- (function(d = normalizePath(getwd())) {
  while (!dir.exists(file.path(d, "imports_stable"))) {
    if (dirname(d) == d) stop("Could not find repo root (folder containing imports_stable/)")
    d <- dirname(d)
  }
  d
})()
imports_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "imports_stable")
outs_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "analysis_outs", "05_in_vitro_differentiation_RNAseq_SIG18")
dir.create(file.path(outs_dir, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(outs_dir, "spca"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
source(file.path(repo_dir, "functions/r_custom/plotting_fxns.R"))
theme_set(theme_Publication())
interaction_palette <- c("#808080",brewer.pal(5,"Dark2"))
names(interaction_palette) <- c("none", "additive over saturation", "buffering",
                      "buffering complete", "synergy negative", "synergy positive")
```

# Import

```{r}
# import ligand component values
codes <- readr::read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/zscore_degs/zscore_degs_unscaled_alpha10.0_sPCA_codes.csv")) 
colnames(codes)[-1] <- paste0("comp_",colnames(codes)[-1])
codes <- codes %>%
  separate(interaction, into = c("ligand1","ligand2","replicate","sex","well","library","project"), sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(library, project)) %>%
  mutate(interaction = paste0(ligand1, "_", ligand2))
```


```{r}
lm_fit <- read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/lm_fit_zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA_clean.csv"))
lm_scored <- read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/lm_scored_zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA_clean.csv")) %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = factor(interaction_class, levels = c("none","buffering","synergy negative","synergy positive")))

# unfiltered interaction model output, used to identify replicate-driven components
# that were excluded from lm_scored/lm_fit during annotation in 03_spca_annotation.Rmd
lm_interaction <- read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/lm_fit_zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA.csv"))
bad_rep_comps <- setdiff(unique(lm_interaction$component), unique(lm_scored$component))
```

# sPCA HM Visualization

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=12}
mat <- codes %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(bad_rep_comps)) %>%
  mutate(interaction = paste(ligand1, ligand2, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames("interaction") %>%
  as.matrix()

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  seq(-4, 4, length.out = 11),
  rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
)

# Plot
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "scaled sPCA loadings",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  column_title = "sPCA components across interactions\nmean across replicates",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "scaled sPCA\nloadings",
    color_bar = "continuous"
  )
)
```


```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
# matrix
mat <- codes %>%
  dplyr::select(-bad_rep_comps) %>%
  mutate(sample = paste(ligand1, ligand2, replicate, sep = "_"),
         interaction = paste(ligand1, ligand2, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("comp_")) %>%
  as.matrix()

# row metadata (interaction), aligned to mat rows
row_meta <- codes %>%
  mutate(sample = paste(ligand1, ligand2, replicate, sep = "_"),
         interaction = paste(ligand1, ligand2, sep = "_")) %>%
  distinct(sample, interaction) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")
row_meta <- row_meta[rownames(mat), , drop = FALSE]

# colors
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(-5, 5, length.out = 11),
                      rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))
ints <- unique(row_meta$interaction)
int_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(length(ints)),
  ints
)

# row annotation
ra <- rowAnnotation(
  interaction = row_meta$interaction,
  col = list(interaction = int_cols),
  annotation_legend_param = list(interaction = list(title = "interaction"))
)

# heatmap
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "scaled sPCA loadings",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  left_annotation = ra,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  column_title = "sPCA components across interactions\nmean across replicates",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "scaled sPCA\nloadings",
    color_bar = "continuous"
  )
)

```


```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
class_levels <- setdiff(names(interaction_palette), "none")
# make heatmap matrix (interactions as rows, components as columns — dropped the final t())
mat <- codes %>%
  dplyr::select(-bad_rep_comps) %>%
  mutate(interaction = paste(ligand1, ligand2, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames("interaction") %>%
  as.matrix()
# make heatmap color scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(-4, 4, length.out = 11), rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))
# make bar plot data (rows = component, matches mat's columns now)
bar_mat <- lm_scored %>%
  filter(p_adj_interaction < 0.1 | p_adj_ligand1 < 0.1 | p_adj_ligand2 < 0.1) %>%
  filter(interaction_class %in% class_levels) %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = factor(interaction_class, levels = class_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::count(component, interaction_class, name = "n") %>%
  complete(component, interaction_class, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = interaction_class, values_from = n, names_expand = TRUE, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("component") %>% as.matrix()
# align bar_mat to mat's columns without dropping any of mat's components
missing_comps <- setdiff(colnames(mat), rownames(bar_mat))
bar_mat <- rbind(bar_mat, matrix(0, nrow = length(missing_comps), ncol = ncol(bar_mat),
                                  dimnames = list(missing_comps, colnames(bar_mat))))
bar_mat <- bar_mat[colnames(mat), class_levels, drop = FALSE]

bars <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  num_interactions = anno_barplot(bar_mat, gp = gpar(fill = interaction_palette[class_levels]),
                       axis_param = list(side = "left")),
  height = unit(45, "mm")
)
ht <- Heatmap(mat, name = "scaled sPCA loadings", col = col_fun,
              cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = TRUE,
              row_names_side = "left",
              top_annotation = bars,
              border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
              heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "scaled\nsPCA\nloadings",
                                          at = seq(-4, 4, by = 2),
                                          color_bar = "continuous",
                                          border = "black"))
bar_legend <- Legend(title = "interaction class", at = class_levels,
                     legend_gp = gpar(fill = interaction_palette[class_levels]))
ht_obj <- draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(bar_legend),
     heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
# component order from hierarchical clustering, reused by 06_spca_ora_analysis.Rmd
# to keep sPCA components in a consistent order across figures
clustered_rows <- tibble(component = colnames(mat)[column_order(ht_obj)])
```

```{r}
pdf(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/spca_alpha10.0_interactions_hm.pdf"), width = 12, height = 5)
draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(bar_legend),
     heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

write_csv(clustered_rows, file.path(outs_dir, "spca/spca_alpha10.0_full_hm_row_order.csv"))
```

# Interactions per Combination

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
# number of significant interaction components per ligand combination,
# stacked by interaction class (same filtering as the heatmap bar annotation)
combo_counts <- lm_scored %>%
  filter(p_adj_interaction < 0.1 | p_adj_ligand1 < 0.1 | p_adj_ligand2 < 0.1) %>%
  filter(interaction_class %in% class_levels) %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = factor(interaction_class, levels = class_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::count(interaction, interaction_class, name = "n") %>%
  complete(interaction, interaction_class, fill = list(n = 0))

# order combinations by total number of interaction components
combo_order <- combo_counts %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(interaction)

p_combo <- combo_counts %>%
  mutate(interaction = factor(interaction, levels = combo_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction, y = n, fill = interaction_class)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = interaction_palette[class_levels], name = "interaction class") +
  labs(x = "ligand combination", y = "number of sPCA components") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        aspect.ratio = 1)
p_combo

ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/spca_alpha10.0_interactions_per_combination_bar.pdf"),
       p_combo)
```

# Define Synergy Comps

```{r}
synergy_pos_comps <- lm_scored %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "synergy positive") %>%
  filter(`freq_synergy positive` > 0.25) %>%
  pull(component) %>%
  unique()
synergy_pos_comps_tgfb <- lm_scored %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "synergy positive") %>%
  filter(interaction == "TGFb_TNF") %>%
  filter(`freq_synergy positive` > 0.25) %>%
  pull(component) %>%
  unique()
synergy_neg_comps <- lm_scored %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "synergy negative") %>%
  filter((`freq_synergy negative` > 0.25)|(freq_buffering > 0.25)) %>%
  pull(component) %>%
  unique()
Th1_top <- lm_fit %>%
  filter(!(component %in% synergy_pos_comps)) %>%
  filter(term == "ligand1Th1") %>%
  slice_min(p_adj, n = 3) %>%
  pull(component)
Th2_top <- lm_fit %>%
  filter(!(component %in% synergy_pos_comps)) %>%
  filter(term == "ligand1Th2") %>%
  slice_min(p_adj, n = 3) %>%
  pull(component)
Th17_top <- lm_fit %>%
  filter(!(component %in% synergy_pos_comps)) %>%
  filter(term == "ligand1Th17") %>%
  slice_min(p_adj, n = 3) %>%
  pull(component)
iTreg_top <- lm_fit %>%
  filter(!(component %in% synergy_pos_comps)) %>%
  filter(term == "ligand1iTreg") %>%
  slice_min(p_adj, n = 3) %>%
  pull(component)
```

# Heatmap All Pos Synergy Comps

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# Define the specific order for the categories
cat_levels <- c("combination", "single")

# define comps
comps <- synergy_pos_comps

# subset and apply factor order
codesTnf <- codes %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    ligand2 == "none" ~ "single",
    ligand1 == "Th0" ~ "single",
    TRUE ~ "combination"
  )) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::select(interaction, replicate, category, all_of(comps))

# Prepare data
mat_prep <- codesTnf %>%
  group_by(interaction, category) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

# Transpose
mat <- mat_prep %>%
  dplyr::select(-category) %>%
  column_to_rownames("interaction") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

# Color function
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(-4, 4, length.out = 11), rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))

# Plot with cluster_column_slices = FALSE to respect factor order
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "scaled sPCA loadings",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = T,
  show_column_dend = T,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  column_split = mat_prep$category,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE, # This enforces the factor level order
  column_title = "TNF family sPCA synergy components",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row Scaled\nsPCA Score")
)
```

```{r}
pdf(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/SIG18_spca_tnf_family_interaction_programs.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "scaled sPCA loadings",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = T,
  show_column_dend = T,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  column_split = mat_prep$category,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE, # This enforces the factor level order
  column_title = "TNF family sPCA synergy components",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row Scaled\nsPCA Score")
)
dev.off()
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
# Define the specific order for the categories
cat_levels <- c("combination", "single")

# Define the specific order for interaction
interaction_levels <- c(
  "Th0_none", "Th0_TNF",
  "Th1_none", "Th1_TNF",
  "Th2_none", "Th2_TNF",
  "Th17_none", "Th17_TNF",
  "iTreg_none", "iTreg_TNF",
  "TGFb_none", "TGFb_TNF"
)

# define comps
comps <- synergy_pos_comps_tgfb

# subset and apply factor order
codesTnf <- codes %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    ligand2 == "none" ~ "single",
    ligand1 == "Th0" ~ "single",
    TRUE ~ "combination"
  )) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)) %>%
  mutate(interaction = factor(interaction, levels = interaction_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::select(interaction, replicate, category, all_of(comps))

# Prepare data
mat_prep <- codesTnf %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) %>%
  arrange(interaction, replicate)

# Transpose
mat <- mat_prep %>%
  mutate(interaction_rep = paste(interaction, replicate, sep = "__")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(category, interaction, replicate)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("interaction_rep") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()  # transpose so comps are rows, samples are columns

# Color function for heatmap body
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(-4, 4, length.out = 11), rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))

# Color mapping for interaction annotation (Paired palette, matched to factor order)
interaction_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(n = length(interaction_levels), name = "Paired"),
  interaction_levels
)

# Column annotation
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  interaction = mat_prep$interaction,
  col = list(interaction = interaction_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# Plot with cluster_row_slices = FALSE to respect factor order
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "scaled sPCA loadings",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_dend = T,
  show_column_dend = T,
  show_column_names = F,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE, # This enforces the factor level order
  top_annotation = col_anno,
  column_title = "TGFb+TNF sPCA positive synergy components",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row Scaled\nsPCA Score")
)

pdf(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/SIG18_spca_tgfb_tnf_interaction_programs_replicates.pdf"), width = 6, height = 3)
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "scaled sPCA loadings",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_dend = T,
  show_column_dend = T,
  show_column_names = F,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE, # This enforces the factor level order
  top_annotation = col_anno,
  column_title = "TGFb+TNF sPCA positive synergy components",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row Scaled\nsPCA Score")
)
dev.off()
```

# FC-FC synergy scores

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
lm_scored %>%
  filter(interaction == "TGFb_TNF") %>%
  mutate(estimate_additive = estimate_ligand1 + estimate_ligand2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate_additive, y = estimate_total_interaction_model)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(color = interaction_class)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = interaction_palette) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/SIG18_spca_tgfb_tnf_coefficient_scatter.pdf"))
```
